newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists less upbeat on AEX index.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists less upbeat on AEX index.

text.p: Dutch chartists were mixed about the short-term prospects for the AEX share index this week, with some seeing increasing resistance to upward progress.
The AEX index ended at 794.30 points on Friday, 13.49 points above the previous Friday, but off the all time high of 801.27 set earlier the same day.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance
Rabo Sec. Up Up 774 767 n/a n/a

ING Barings -- The AEX is quickly losing momentum at the upper side of its rising trend channel. A minor top on the money flow indicators suggests that some selling pressure is kicking in as the market was making its latest string of all time highs. It seems that, on a very short term basis, there is not much enthusiasm to lift the AEX beyond the psychological 800 mark. A close below its fast 9-day moving average around 790 would violate the steep rising trend channel. Next support comes in around 775, then at 749.
JAAD -- The 800 boundary seems to give a bit more resistance than anticipated, but the uptrend is still intact.

MeesPierson -- Last week's rally came as a surprise to us. Nevertheless we believe that our neagtive forecast , as described in MeesPiersons's last comment, will start this week. We expect a small correction, into the direction of the 742 level.

We see a dollar movings sideways, with support around the 1.87 level. Furthermore, we are very cautious about the Dow. The Dow is testing the support level (around 7200) of the trading range. Breaking through would mean a correction to at least 7000.
RABO Securities -- After reaching the price target at 790, the AEX pushed through the 800 level. It is obvious that the uptrend is still intact and we remain bullish on the AEX.

We expect the AEX to test the upper boundary of its newly-formed short-term upward sloping trend channel, which is currently at approximately 808-810. The lower boundary is corresponding with the support at 767. A break of this level would damage this short-term bullish outlook.
